segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין אַלְמָנָה נִפְרַעַת מִנִּכְסֵי יְתוֹמִים, אֶלָּא בִּשְׁבוּעָה. נִמְנְעוּ מִלְּהַשְׁבִּיעָהּ; הִתְקִין רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל הַזָּקֵן, שֶׁתְּהֵא נוֹדֶרֶת לַיְּתוֹמִים כֹּל מַה שֶּׁיִּרְצוּ, וְגוֹבָה כְּתוּבָּתָהּ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A widow can collect» payment of her marriage contract «from the property of orphans only by» means of «an oath» that she did not receive any part of the payment of the marriage contract during her husband’s lifetime. The mishna relates: The courts «refrained from administering an oath to her,» leaving the widow unable to collect payment of her marriage contract. «Rabban Gamliel the Elder instituted that she should take, for» the benefit of «the orphans, any vow that» the orphans «wished» to administer to her, e.g., that all produce will become prohibited to her if she received any payment of her marriage contract, «and» after stating this vow, she «collects» payment of «her marriage contract.»

segments.he: הָעֵדִים חוֹתְמִין עַל הַגֵּט, מִפְּנֵי תִּיקּוּן הָעוֹלָם. וְהִלֵּל הִתְקִין פְּרוֹזְבּוּל, מִפְּנֵי תִּיקּוּן הָעוֹלָם.
segments.en: The mishna lists additional ordinances that were instituted for the betterment of the world: «The witnesses sign» their names «on the bill of divorce,» even though the bill of divorce is valid without their signatures, «for the betterment of the world,» as the Gemara will explain. «And Hillel instituted a document that prevents the Sabbatical» Year «from abrogating an outstanding debt [prosbol] for the betterment of the world,» as the Gemara will explain.
